name: Cinder
description: a will-o'-the-wisp: a single floating fireball shaped like a teardrop, the size of a fist, white-yellow hot core and orange-red flickering edges, with a cute mischievous face painted inside the flame (two beady black eyes and a grin), a wisp of smoke and a few sparks trailing behind it

poses.stand: floating in the air, its flame tip flickering upward
poses.popped: bursting apart into a scatter of tiny sparks and a puff of smoke

idle.action: floats in place, its flame flickering and wobbling, blinking its eyes

move.action: leans forward and drifts toward the right, its flame streaming backward, staying in the same spot in the frame

die.action: puffs up and pops into a burst of sparks and smoke

prompts.standFromText: Paint {description}. Seen from the side, small and centered in the frame with lots of empty space around it. It is a ball of fire that floats in the air by itself. {style} {background}
prompts.pose: Image 1 is {description}. Show this exact same object, the same design, {action}. Keep its shape, colors, size and position in the frame and the painterly art style of image 1. {background}

style: Painterly digital painting in the style of dark fantasy video game art: soft visible brush strokes, rich shading, gritty and detailed, warm hellfire rim light, high resolution and smooth (not pixel art, not a cartoon).
